purpose: Automation template for reusable project-specific agents.
success_criteria: The agent can be configured quickly and execute safe automation tasks.
trigger: A task is submitted via CLI or queue.

model.note: Override per-subagent in agents/<name>/AGENT.md via 'model:' frontmatter key.

tool_permissions.note: Only the final subagent in a chain (leaf) may use write tools. Set 'can_write: true' in AGENT.md frontmatter.

connectors.note: All external data sources must be declared in connectors.yaml before use.

autonomy_note: Approval is required by default (autonomy_level 'gated'). Set autonomy_level to 'max' only as an explicit, auditable opt-in for trusted low-risk deployments. See platform/security/00-security-architecture.md (fail-closed doctrine).

agent.domain_expertise: Project and process knowledge comes from the project pack.
agent.hard_limits: Human approval is required for high-risk actions and configured approval categories.

workflow.name: main
steps: Use the best tool or subagent
workflow.validation: Verify the output before marking the task complete.
workflow.escalation: Escalate high-risk actions and configured approval categories for human approval.

memory.forever: Roles, processes, and important project conventions.
memory.between_runs: Recent actions, learnings, and recurring patterns.
